name: Arena
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one NEW Arena mobile battle-page background in this exact game's illustrated style. Input 1 is the approved cave background: match its quiet composition, large simple forms, soft contrast and outline treatment. Input 2 is a style reference for the game's chunky clean silhouettes; do not copy its gate. STYLE: Match the supplied game art: clean chunky cartoon illustration, simple broad 2-3 tone cel-shaded shapes, confident muted dark-plum contours on edge objects, no photorealism, fine texture, tiny cracks, grain, 3D rendering, excessive gradients or intricate details. Theme palette: warm sandy beige, muted limestone, dusty burgundy and soft slate blue.
SCENE: A small friendly fantasy colosseum, with broad low-detail stone seating and arches confined to the distant upper band and outer sides. Two unequal subdued cloth banners tucked at far edges, one burgundy and one dusty blue. Wide empty pale sand arena floor fills the central and lower areas. No crowds, weapons, trophies, gates in the center, markings or battle props.
COMPOSITION: 9:20 portrait, 1440 x 3200. The board and UI cover most of the central upper area. Keep the central 76% of the width quiet and mostly featureless; put the theme's bold recognizable details at asymmetric extreme sides and corners, with varied shape, height and spacing. Avoid matching rows or repetitive paired clusters. Keep a broad low-contrast floor in the lower half, which matches this board material: light warm beige packed arena sand with faint irregular dusty tan patches and a few very subtle flat scuffs; no circles, tracks, footprints, symbols, stonework or props. Board and panels must read clearly. No high-contrast rocks, liquid, branches or objects crossing the central clearing. Keep details visible close enough to the sides for a narrow phone composition, but modest in size. Restrained gentle dark-plum outline weights like input 1; clean bold outer contours on side objects. No board, grid lines, purple divider, baked frame, rounded-corner mask, icons, characters, text or labels. Full bleed opaque image. Output only ONE finished background, no collage or comparison.
